biggest_catch: The rumored $50 new-account bonus could not be confirmed on any issuer-official page — treat any third-party claim of a Target welcome offer as unverified.
catches: Conflicting non-authoritative sources claim a $50 Target Circle Rewards new-account bonus, but no current issuer-official page text confirms it — evidence is not solid.
Credible independent reviews list the Target Circle Card as having no signup bonus.
The card's real value is an instant 5% discount at Target checkout, not a bonus payout.
The 29.45% variable APR destroys any savings fast if you carry a balance; pay in full.
Store credit card version can only be used at Target/Target.com; only the Mastercard version works elsewhere.
Hard credit inquiry through TD Bank USA for the credit versions.

c1.reason: The official Target application page (target.com/circlecard/credit-card-application) loaded live but rendered no readable text (JS-only); no issuer-official bonus terms could be captured.

c2.reason: No concrete payout confirmed in official terms — third-party claims of a $50 Circle Rewards bonus are affiliate-style and unverifiable on the official page.

c3.reason: Cannot confirm the offer is current; credible sources list 'Signup Bonus: None' while low-quality aggregators claim $50 — unclear, so reject per rule.

c4.reason: Timing is moot for a reject; no confirmed bonus payout exists to time.

eligibility: Credit versions issued by TD Bank USA, N.A.; subject to credit approval.
Store card usable only at Target stores and Target.com; Mastercard version usable anywhere Mastercard is accepted.
Applicants generally need to be 18+ with a U.S. address and SSN.
notes: Target's official credit application page was loaded live but is a JavaScript-only page whose offer text could not be extracted. Low-quality aggregator sites (careerspages, totaljobshub, pdfjet) claim a $50 Target Circle Rewards new-account bonus, but these read as affiliate/content-farm material and no issuer-official page text confirms a current offer. Credible independent reviews (cardrates, updated Sept 2026) list 'Signup Bonus: None.' Failed checklist code: c2/c3 — unclear or affiliate-only, expired, or not solid. Never invent numbers.
